t: High quality, durable design. Creates smooth edge on a workpiece and precise, flat bottomed grooves. Ideal for softwood, hardwood, MDF, plywood and chipboard. Recommended for use with hand-held and 1/4" routers.
b: Suitable for Cutting Softwood, Hardwood, Laminate, Veneer Wood, Plywood, Chipboard, Fibreboard & Sandwich Material
